abstract: Recently, we experienced two cases of testicular tumor in patients with cryptorchidism. Case 1: A 35-year-old man was admitted because of right inguinal mass. He had a tumor of right undescended testis and underwent right orchiectomy. Case 2: A 45-year-old man, who was pointed out to have bilateral cryptorchidism was admitted because of right groin mass. He underwent right orchiectomy and left orchiopexy. Histological examination of two cases were seminoma. Testicular tumor in undescended testis was made with 179 reported cases from the Japanese literature.
abstract_ja: 最近、停留精巣を有する患者に精巣腫瘍を経験した。症例1:35歳男性が右鼠径部腫瘤で入院。右停留精巣に腫瘍があり、右精巣摘除術を施行。症例2:両側停留精巣を指摘された45歳男性が右鼠径部腫瘤で入院。右精巣摘除術および左精巣固定術を施行。両症例の組織学的検査はセミノーマであった。停留精巣に生じた精巣腫瘍について、日本の文献から報告された179例をまとめた。
